title: MOSHPIT: Accessible; reproducible metagenome data science on the QIIME 2 framework.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no PMCID, no open full text, no supplement, no accessions in the text or text-mined, nothing found on Zenodo/Dryad. Fetched moshpit.qiime2.org: it is a software documentation site (Read the Docs) for the pipeline, not a dataset release.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: MOSHPIT is a software toolkit for shotgun metagenome analysis (sequencing all DNA in a microbial sample) built on QIIME 2, a microbiome analysis framework. It wraps existing tools and adds provenance tracking (a record of every processing step). No new labelled dataset is described.

a1_downloadable.note: This is a software paper. No dataset is attached: no accessions, no supplement, no repository deposit found; the website is software docs. Checked via paper_context.py and the project website.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: There is no label table at all; any prediction target would have to be built from someone else's metagenome data run through the pipeline.

a3_inputs_present.note: No input data released with the paper.

a6_fits_laptop.note: No dataset; raw metagenome reads would be far beyond a laptop working set anyway.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No counts to compare; full text not open access.

a8_label_provenance.note: No label exists; any outputs would be the pipeline's own predictions (taxonomy, gene annotations), which would be circular.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the paper releases software, not a labelled dataset.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use metagenome pipeline outputs to predict sample traits; no dataset supplied, so the project is undefined.
plain_idea.train_on: Nothing from this paper; it publishes a software toolkit with no attached data. Example count: unknown (none).
plain_idea.predict: No measured outcome is provided; the pipeline's own outputs (taxonomy, annotations) are tool predictions, not ground truth.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Not worthwhile as an ML project; the toolkit might be useful for preprocessing in some other metagenome project.

ml_idea: None from this paper. MOSHPIT could only serve as a preprocessing tool for a separate metagenome dataset that has its own measured labels.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: no dataset exists to estimate on.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already done: no accessions, supplement or data deposit linked to the paper; website is software docs.

verdict_reason: Software/tool paper with no attached dataset or labels (A1, A2 fail); full text is paywalled and no accessions or deposits were found.
